caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical arrangement of stylized botanical elements centered around a vase. The vase is positioned at the bottom center, drawn in muted beige and brown tones, with decorative spiral handles on either side. Emerging from the vase are large green leaves and numerous trailing branches tipped with smaller leaves and flower-like shapes. The leaves are mostly dark green with lighter highlights, and many of the flowers have red, black, and cream-colored accents. The background of the drawing is a tan or light brown color, creating a contrast with the darker and more vibrant colors of the plant. The composition is framed by a border on the left and right, featuring repeated floral motifs in similar colors—green leaves and red flowers—arranged vertically. The drawing also exhibits minor signs of wear, with some parts appearing faded or chipped.
title: Wall Painting
